faqs.question: Do you set up the email platform too?
faqs.answer: We can write within your existing platform (Mailchimp, Klaviyo, etc.) or help set one up and connect it to your audience.

faqs.question: How often should we send?
faqs.answer: We help you find a sustainable cadence that keeps your list engaged without fatigue — quality over volume.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, configurations, and documentation. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
